name: gta6-animated-short
description: Flat 2D cartoon short engine (three.js drawn, Remotion encoded). A short = a project/ folder.

scripts.stills: remotion render src/index.ts Stills out/stills --sequence --image-format=png --gl=angle --log=error && node tools/name-stills.mjs out/stills
scripts.keys: remotion render src/index.ts Keys out/keys --sequence --image-format=jpeg --gl=angle --log=error && node tools/name-stills.mjs out/keys --keys
